card.name: Final pieces of drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name that has been split into several parts, such as the ending of a generic or brand name. It appears in drug labels, often just before a following word like potassium, hydrochloride or a verb.

modes.label: Generic name endings
modes.description: Closing piece of a generic drug name, such as -ate, -ide or -ine.

modes.label: Brand name endings
modes.description: Closing piece of an uppercase brand name split into parts.
modes.example: ORLADE<<YO>> is recommended [see Use in Specific Pop
